notes.title: Vorax: 2 weeks to release
notes.notes:
Operatives,

As we move into the final phase before the early access release of "Vorax," scheduled for July 18th, it is crucial to brief you on the latest developments and newly integrated content. This bulletin will cover enemy updates, new playable areas, and additional weapons.

Among the new threats identified on the island are the Spitflowers, a particularly dangerous form of infected flora. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/dc5fc08e3d5d4738bb00707f9d3b2971ed554080.png
These plant-based adversaries are a grotesque hybrid of vegetal and human DNA. Though the exact origins of Spitflowers are shrouded in mystery, it is known that a scientist with a dark sense of humor was responsible for their creation. This scientist was infamous for his eerie laughter, and it seems his creations have inherited this trait, as they can sometimes be heard screaming and laughing in the night. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/baea1478eb10336798bb6bc9abf38a2d5abc3858.pngThese abominations discharge toxic projectiles, posing a significant threat to anyone within their range. Engage with caution and neutralize them from a distance where possible. It is important to note that Spitflowers are not an isolated mutation; much of the island's flora has been similarly infected, creating an environment where even the vegetation is hostile.

A new formidable enemy has also been identified: the Carapx Boss. This heavily armored behemoth requires tactical precision and specialized weaponry for engagement. Its resilient exterior makes it a high-priority target that should not be underestimated.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/e742bdfb0c08589f5d3051a80891b05e31dbebbe.png

In terms of exploration, several new areas have been made accessible. The School, a strategic location equipped with a secret military vault, demands both combat readiness and investigative skills. The Electric Central, a critical infrastructure zone, is essential for restoring power to the island and enabling further exploration. The Olive Factory introduces complex machinery and processing equipment, offering opportunities for resource gathering and tactical engagements. Lastly, the Sanctuary, a historical site now compromised, provides strategic vantage points but is fraught with hidden threats.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/382cea3dc848aa2f8cab6043a56f9cf6fdd3e4ee.png
Our arsenal has been significantly expanded to meet these new challenges. Sticky Bombs, designed for precision placement, are effective against heavily armored enemies and strategic targets. Organic Bait Traps lure and incapacitate mutants, providing versatile options for both offensive and defensive strategies. Additional weapons have been integrated to ensure tactical versatility; detailed operational manuals will be provided upon acquisition.

This extensive content update will be part of the "Vorax" early access release on July 18th. Operatives are expected to familiarize themselves with the new threats, environments, and tools to maximize mission success.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/18a00a4bda75121d316ac40c29bfa6d854a6b2c6.png
Stay vigilant and prepared. Further instructions will follow as we approach the release date.

Mission Control out.

The Vorax Development Team

WISHLIST NOW.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/

notes.title: Die Young is out on PS4 & a new PC 1.2.5 Update!
notes.notes:
Die Young is now available on PlayStation 4
https://i.imgur.com/XibGgcm.png
Happy New Year! 2020 has been a long year full of unpleasant surprises, but we wanted to start 2021 strong and with two pleasant surprises.

Firstly, Die Young is now available on the PlayStation Store. We know it may seem a bit odd to some for us to post an announcement here on Steam, but we simply couldn't contain our excitement and we wanted to share it with our fans, especially the ones who have been requesting this version for a while now. 

Die Young is out now on PS4 in English, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish (screen languages). For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent.

Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.

Secondly, we have not forgotten about our PC fans. Die Young just got updated on Steam. Here are the release notes:

Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:

CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5

- fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).

- fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)

- fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)

- fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)

- AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)

- Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)

- fix for bug in  The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)

- fix for various graphic bugs

- various fixes in level design

Enjoy!

Hi Everybody!

Today we are very proud to announce a majore release patch for Die Young.
1.0.30.20 where many things were added, 
the most important are RUSSIAN and SPANISH languages!

Since its release the 12 of September, thousands of you played Die Young and we are very happy.

We are still finalizing Italian ( it's our native language so we want to make things right ;-) ) and it should be ready for next week when also official soundtrack will be released.

We also add Trading cards in this patch, we hope you like it!

Full changelog 1.0.30.20

 added Russian language
 added Spanish language
 The executioner now despawns after crossing Underworld Passage
 Now the Executioner keys (Blood-soaked Keys) also open the gates of the passage that directly connects Dry Riverbed and Stone Pillars.
 fix of some quests that were not completed correctly

 graphix fixes/ improvements on several npc animations

notes.title: Update [1.11] is out!
notes.notes:
A new bug-fix update is out. In this update we also included
the possibility to play music in-game (disabled by default).

Of course, we are still working on the *special* vehicle, 
which will be introduced in the next update.
Soon we will reveal some additional details on such vehicle.


[1.11]

- [Music] Music could be enabled (from the settings panel -> audio settings) to play in-game
- [Music] More music tracks are present in-game

- [General] Better networking synchronization of player positions
- [General] "Quick match" prioritizes official servers
- [General] A Hunt match now ends when the amount of collected Blocktanium reaches a certain threshold

- [GUI] Full log is shown when the chat input is opened
- [GUI] "skin" is written on the skin button
- [GUI] "Saved successfully."/error message is shown when saving
- [GUI] Better graphics inside "Quick match" panel

- [Fix] Fixed Slim Turret orientation
- [Fix] Pad is disabled by default, so it should not spin randomly at start
- [Fix] Fixed explosives at match restart
- [Fix] Fixed flashlight at match restart
- [Fix] NPCs were added multiple times in the prefab panel (map editor)
- [Fix] Equipment stands were visible at a very high distance
- [Fix] Downloaded assets are deleted also when hitting Alt-F4
- [Fix] Fixed an error on the target area panel 
- [Fix] Castle Battle team area was disappearing during build phase
- [Fix] Last updated introduced some errors on Shovel behaviour
- [Fix] Fixed Zombies' running animation
- [Fix] Sometimes builtin NPCs prefabs were disappearing from the prefabs panel
- [Fix] Fixed a bug in the HUD (a number was shown in the bottom-right corner of the screen in DM/TDM/AST game modes)
- [Fix] Minor Fixes

notes.title: Update 0.96 is out!
notes.notes:
Update 0.96 is out!
Thanks to all users for helping us with their feedbacks!

"The Mall" (Deathmatch)
http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/41972545101726218/70C81DCF864CC5B777CAF1ECF84F5C566AFBF54E/

"Ruins" (Deathmatch, Team deathmatch)
http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/41972545101722256/2969E349AACA021F20305BBCE3477282A6EA55D2/

- [Maps] Map "The Mall" added (Deathmatch)
- [Maps] Map "Ruins" added (Deathmatch, Team deathmatch)
- [Maps] At the end of the match, on dedicated servers users could vote the next map using F1, F2, F3, ... keys
(map playlists on user-hosted servers will come in future updates)

- [General] Upgraded codebase to Unity3D 4.5.1
- [General] Now mature content should be reported as "mature" (the checkbox should be activated inside the informations panel of the asset)
- [General] It's possible to show/hide all custom characters reported as mature (by default, hide all mature content)
- [General] It's possible to choose to show/hide each single custom character despite the mature property
- [General] The player that hosts a match could kick griefers
- [General] When a player kills his own team mates 2 times or more, he will raise a vote kick against him
- [General] Players could report to server that another player is offensive or hasn't reported his character as "mature".
Each custom character used by an offensive player will be considered as mature, also his chat will be disabled on that server.
- [General] Far terrain/characters are shown/hidden chunk by chunk

- [GUI] A new panel was added to see characters that are currently used by players
- [GUI] Now it's possible to chat also when the game is over

- [Editor] It's possible to lock use/modify for custom characters and maps
- [Editor] It's possible to know the resistance of blocks from tooltips inside the blockset panel
- [Editor] Menu buttons now have tooltips

- [Weapons] Aim is slightly more precise and less smooth
- [Weapons] Improved Shotgun
- [Weapons] Sniper delay before reload was removed
- [Weapons] Sniper kills with one-shot on the whole body
- [Weapons] Better lag management for bullets

- [Fix] Fixed some freeze problems on Linux
- [Fix] Fixed author field for custom characters
- [Fix] Fixed the collider of the claymore
- [Fix] Fixed fog on linux
- [Fix] Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.95 is out!
notes.notes:
The following changes are all based on the suggestions made by the AWESOME community of Blockstorm in official forums and Steam forums!


 [Maps] Deathmatch map "Medieval Hell" added
http://s13.postimg.org/yi6d1ejwn/medhellprev.png
 [Maps] Assault map "Outpost Attack" added
http://s10.postimg.org/76x8z25dl/outpostpreview.png
 [Maps] "Bridge Pass" has an indestructible layer under the helipad
 [Maps] "Bridge Pass" is also available in the official Team Deathmatch servers

 [Gameplay] Kill assists now have a proper score (not yet counted in statistics, but we'll add them soon)
 [Gameplay] Death by falling over is no more considered as suicide if there's a cause like an explosion, a falling structure or a burst of bullets. On the countrary, the kill score is assigned to the causing player(s).
 [Gameplay] Explosions propagates to near explosives

 [GUI] Chat and events are split in two logs for better readability
 [GUI] "Tab" key let you see also older chat messages and events

 [Weapons] The reload time of the Shotgun/Shorty depends on the number of shells to be charged.
 [Weapons] Sniper inertia effect is slightly lowered
 [Weapons] The Rocket launcher now has a delay between shoot and the actual rocket launch to avoid overuse in short distances.
 [Weapons] Shotgun hitten graphics (the red arc) was reversed, now it's fixed
 [Weapons] AK47, Handgun, M240 precision was slightly modified

 [Audio] Fixed some bugs on weapon recharge
 [Performance] Faster load time for characters
 [Performance] Better lag management

 [Fix] Fixed a problem when falling into lava
 [Fix] Fixed a speed issue when jumping and aiming
 [Fix] Fixed some problems when placing explosives
 [Fix] Minor bug fixes
